# mpocock

Writes down what a session established, what it decided, and what is still open, in a form a fresh agent reads instead of the transcript. Use it before context runs out, before handing a long pipeline to a successor, or when another session continues the work.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`handoff`](skills/handoff/README.md) | Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up. |

## Hooks

Ships hooks under `hooks/` for `claude`, `codex`. Plugin installation wires them.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install mpocock@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add mpocock@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install mpocock@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
